instrument: Bill 79-26, extension of the data center moratorium
summary: Council voted Sept 22, 2026 to extend its moratorium through December 2027. The moratorium bars issuing data center permits and approving related development plans and zoning petitions; the original one-year moratorium (Feb 2026) would have expired January 2027.
notes: CORRECTION: status updated from proposed (vote scheduled) to adopted.
